metadata.title: Prehospital Stroke Treatment Trials in Conventional EMS Settings: An Expert Consensus Statement on Operational, Ethical, and Technological Priorities
top_takeaways: To optimize prehospital stroke trials in conventional EMS settings, investigators must utilize pragmatic designs, emergency consent models, ultra-early endpoint selection, and scalable technology. This standardized consensus framework provides practicing neurologists with actionable guidance to ensure scientific rigor, ethical feasibility, and equitable access in hyperacute prehospital care.
